title: Quotinator Per-Source Quote-Exclusion File
description: A minimal, hand-authored list of quote ids to skip entirely during import (#219) — for a raw upstream duplicate or unverifiable entry that a conflict-resolution rule or source alias cannot fix, since those only ever correct a field on a quote that does get imported, never decide whether one should be imported at all. One exclusion file per bundled source, referenced from that source's own manifest.json entry via excludeFile.

exclusions.description: Every quote this file excludes. Empty for a source with no known exclusions.

id.description: The excluded quote's own id, exactly as it appears in the source file (matched case-insensitively).

reason.description: Why this quote is excluded, for a future reader auditing the file — not read by any code path.
